value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task 'Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball' implies a sequential order ('Get into...' then 'Pick up...'), which requires a hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) clause to encode this logical dependency, even though environment physics guarantees it (per System Prompt Review Checklist 8: 'An order the task states needs its Precedence even when the environment already guarantees it'). Additionally, Existence(target_room_entered) is redundant given the chain logic where the last hard Existence forces earlier steps in an order (per Worked Example 'Do a, then b' uses Existence(b) + Precedence(a, b), not Existence(a)), so remove Existence(target_room_entered). Keep Existence(target_picked_up) and add Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up).
